name: Oracle — CREATE TABLE by Unexpected Principal
description:
Attacker objective
Stage sensitive data for theft by copying tables (CREATE TABLE AS SELECT) before exfiltration.

Attack logic
CTAS in production is normally an ETL operation by a known service account. CREATE TABLE by any other principal — especially copying client or account tables — is data-staging behaviour.

Why this detection works
Unified Audit records the statement and principal, so allowlisting ETL makes other CTAS a high-signal event.

False positives
A new ETL/reporting account.

Tuning
Allowlist verified accounts; review the CTAS source table for sensitivity.

Required telemetry
Oracle Unified Audit shipped as apps-* (ACTION_NAME, USERNAME, SQL_TEXT).
author: raadabujaish
note:
## Investigation guide
1. SQL_TEXT shows the CTAS source; copying sensitive client/account tables by an unexpected actor is data-staging for theft.
2. Correlate with any subsequent DB-link creation or large outbound transfer from the DB host.
